about.en: SBETon is the Ondo tokenized stock for SharpLink (Nasdaq: SBET, formerly SharpLink Gaming), issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by SBET shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xfDb46864A7C476F0914c5E82CdED3364a9F56F8a, with deployments on BNB Chain and Solana.
